TextBlock.Text: Protect Nimitz against four bombers on two raid axes. Fictional 2025 operation; requires F-23A Block 40 and Block 40 Strike.

Two Block 40 fighters start airborne. Nimitz carries four additional fighters; the first reserve pair is queued at the beginning. Use Flight Deck to launch them, ready the second pair and recover survivors.

Two bombers approach from the east. Two more approach from the northeast on a longer route, with later attack orders. Three fighters screen the first axis. The four bombers have direct orders to attack Nimitz.

Destroy all four bombers and clear incoming weapons while Nimitz remains afloat. Carrier loss, neutral loss or the deadline fails. Preserving the original airborne pair earns a bonus. Launches and recovery are player-controlled; they are not required to trigger victory.

Your aircraft start airborne and selected, with weapons and fuel loaded. Two-aircraft flights begin in Vic formation. Give route and attack orders to the flight leader, or detach a wingman for independent tasking.

Fictional naval F-23 development in September 2025. The carrier, supporting units and legacy opposition are scenario stand-ins. Radar silence does not guarantee invisibility. Neutral losses anywhere in the scenario fail the operation.
